svg.text: Contract Reviews and Profile Update Review -- Sprint 4

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
+ GET /contracts/:id/reviews
+ POST /contracts/:id/reviews
+ GET /reviews/:id
+ PATCH /reviews/:id
+ DELETE /reviews/:id
+ POST /reviews/:id/response
+ PATCH /reviews/responses/:id
+ DELETE /reviews/responses/:id

- service: ReviewService
+ list(userId, contractId)
+ create(userId, contractId, body)
+ detail(userId, reviewId)
+ update(userId, reviewId, body)
+ remove(userId, reviewId)
+ respond(userId, reviewId, body)
+ updateResponse(userId, responseId, body)
+ removeResponse(userId, responseId)

- repository: ReviewRepository
+ list(userId, contractId)
+ detail(userId, reviewId)
+ create(userId, contractId, input)
+ update(userId, reviewId, input)
+ remove(userId, reviewId)
+ respond(userId, reviewId, responseText)
+ updateResponse(userId, responseId, text)
+ removeResponse(userId, responseId)
- requireContractParticipant(userId, contractId)

- prisma: PrismaService
+ findContract(contractId)
+ findById(reviewId)
+ findByContractAndReviewer(contractId, userId)
+ findManyByContract(contractId)
+ create(...), update(...), softDelete(... )
+ findResponseByReview(reviewId)
+ findResponseById(responseId)
+ createResponse(...), updateResponse(... )
+ softDeleteResponse(responseId)

- service: ProfileRevisionService
+ latest(userId, profileType)
+ list(filter)
+ detail(id)
+ approve(id, adminId, body)
+ reject(id, adminId, body)

- repository: ProfileRevisionRepository
+ requiresManualReview(profileStrength)
+ submitFreelancer(userId, input)
+ submitClient(userId, input)
+ submitExpert(userId, input)
+ submitGeneral(userId, input)
+ latestForUser(userId, profileType)
+ list(filter)
+ detail(id)
+ approve(id, adminId, notes)
+ reject(id, adminId, notes)

- prisma: PrismaService
+ submit(data)
+ syncLowStrengthProfiles(threshold)
+ findMany(params)
+ review(id, adminId, decision)
